<entry id="C00766">
<head-word>גִּינִיסְיָא, </head-word>
<head-word>גִּינִיסִין, </head-word>
<head-word>(גִּינוּ', </head-word>
<head-word>גְּנוּ')</head-word>
<pos> m. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (γενέσια, τὰ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (with יום) 
<italic>bithday festival, anniversary of death</italic>
<italic>;</italic> in gen. 
<italic>commemorative festival</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Esth. III, 8. Targ. Y. Gen. XL, 20 גְּנוּסָא (v. גְּנִיסָא a. גְּנוּסַיָּיא).—Ab. Zar. I, 3 (8
<sup>a</sup>) יום ג' של מלכים royal anniversaries, expl. Y. ib. 39
<sup>c</sup> birthday festival (with ref. to Gen. XL, 20, v. supra); Bab. ib. 10
<sup>a</sup> (after discussion) יום שמעמידין בו המלך installation of a king (Roman emperor). Y. R. Hash. III, 59
<sup>a</sup> top; Yalk. Hab. 564. Ex. R. s. 15 יום ג' an anniversary (commemorative of his delivery); a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (= γενέθλια) 
<italic>descent, nobility of birth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. Naḥămu p. 126
<sup>ab</sup>; Yalk. Gen. 162 הודעתם ג' שלי (Gen. R. s. 100 הודעתי הוגנוסים corr. acc.) ye have made known my noble descent. Pesik. Haḥod. p. 53
<sup>a</sup> בת גִּינוּסִים; Pesik. R. s. 15 בת גינסין (read גִּינִיסִין, Yalk. Ex. 190 only בת טובים) a woman of noble birth. Cant. R. to I, 2; a. fr. [Sot. 36
<sup>b</sup> גְּנִיסֵי מלכות וכ' Ar. (ed. גְּנוּנֵי) I recognize in him royal nobility.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<definition> (גנן, v. 
<xref rid="C01072">גַּן</xref>) 
<italic>garden</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. II, 8. Targ. Y. I Gen. XLXI, 4 גינא (Y. II גַּנָּא). Targ. Ps. LVI, 14 (second vers.). Constr. גִּינַּת. Targ. Deut. XI, 10; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 80 (prov.) לפום ג' גננא as the garden so the gardener (as the people so the leader); Y. Snh. II, 20
<sup>d</sup> top כגִנְּתָה כן גננה. B. Bath. 54
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. גִּינָּתָא,</plural-form> constr. גִּינָּת. Targ. Koh. II, 5.—גִּינָּן, גִּנָּן. Targ. Is. LXV, 3; LXVI, 17 (some ed. גַּנָּן; v. גיניאך). V. גַּנָּא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

R. to l. c. ששה ג' היה פותח וכ' (ed. ניסין, נוסין, corr. acc.) six treasuries he opened to them &c.; (Yalk. Esth. 1046 תסבוריות; Targ. II Esth. I, 4 בי גנזי).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="C00773">

<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>

<italic>intimate, familiar</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> ג' ביה she was on familiar terms with him.—
<plural-form>Pl. גִּיסֵי, גָיְיסֵי</plural-form>. Ib. 33
<sup>a</sup> דגִי' בה רבנן where scholars are a familiar sight (and no attention is paid them). Keth. 28

<entry id="C00777">
<head-word>גִּיסָא, </head-word>
<hw-number>III</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (גוס II) 
<italic>neighborhood, side</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 33
<sup>a</sup> באידך ג' on the other side (of the river); Erub. 16
<sup>b</sup>. Sabb. 110
<sup>a</sup> בההוא ג' וכ' in a certain neighborhood of &c.—Yoma 77
<sup>b</sup>. Bekh. 44
<sup>b</sup> אַגִּ' sideways. Koh. R. to VII, 9 when the kettle boils over, על גיסיה שפיך it pours over its own sides (wrath will hurt none but the man himself); a. fr.—Trnsf. 
<italic>way, manner</italic>. Gitt. 67
<sup>b</sup> some argue להאי ג' וכ' one way and some the other way; a. fr.—Nidd. 66
<sup>a</sup> [read:] לא תגלי … דכי היכי דתהוו עליך להן ג' וכ' (v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. דם IV, 75
<sup>2</sup>) do not tell thy friends, for as they wondered over thee on the one side (over thy bad luck), they may wonder on the other side (over thy good fortune, and bewitch it). [Ḥull. 17
<sup>b</sup> אתרי גִיסָנֵי, Sh’eltoth d’R. Aḥai 92, ed. אתלת רוחתא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>גִּיסְטְרָא, </head-word>

<head-word>גִּצְטְרָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= גזרזרא, a reduplic.</definition>
<notes> of גזר; for assimilation of sibilants cmp. Nöld. Mand. Gr. p. 45 sq.) 
<italic>something defective, mutilated</italic>
<italic>;</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>a large vessel which turned out defective or unwieldy</italic>, by having its handles broken off or being cracked, and is therefore used as a 
<italic>receptacle for refuse, </italic>as
<italic> a pickling pot</italic>, as 
<italic>a receiver of drippings</italic> from a leaking vessel &c. Kel. II, 6 גס' שנמצאת וכ' 
<language-key>(Ar. </language-key>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to roll, turn</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVI לגַלְגֵּל וכ' to roll (move) the stone.—Y. Sabb. III, 6
<sup>a</sup> top מְגַלְגְּלִין ביצה וכ' you may roll an egg (for roasting) on &c. Ḥall. III, 1 גִּלְגְּלָה (בחטים) when she has formed the dough (of wheat) by rolling; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְגוּלְגָּל, f. מְגוּלְגֶּלֶת; pl. מְגוּלְגָּלִים, מְגוּלְגָּלִין; מְגוּלְגָּלוֹת. 1) 
<italic>rolled</italic>. Pes. 7
<sup>a</sup> עיסה מג' a formed dough. Y. Sot. I, 16
<sup>c</sup> bot. ביצים מג' roasted eggs; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>rounded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 16
<sup>b</sup> מה עדשה זו מְגוּלְגֶּלֶת אף אבילות מִגַּלְגֶּלֶת וכ' as the lentil is rounded, so does mourning roll and go around (different version in Ms., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, a. in Yalk. Gen. 110, v. גַּלְגַּל). [Men. 86
<sup>a</sup>, v. גִּרְגֵּר.].—2) (with על) 
<italic>to roll upon, to put on one’s shoulders, to burden, tax, assess</italic>. Keth. VIII, 1 (78
<sup>a</sup>) אתם מגלגלים עלינו וכ' you burden us with old restrictive laws. Y. Shebi. IV, 35
<sup>b</sup> אתם מג' וכ' ye impose upon us taxes &c. Y. B. Bath. I, beg. 12
<sup>d</sup> מג' עליו וכ' you make him bear the expenses for &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to bring about, cause</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 32
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. Yoma V (IV), 12 מגלגלין זכות ע"י וכ' good things are brought about through the agency of good men &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="C00959">גָּלַל</xref> Nif.) 
<italic>to overcome</italic> (one’s own feelings), 
<italic>to put up with, bear with</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 67
<sup>b</sup> רצונך שתְּגַלְגֵּל עמי בעדשים will you bear with me when I offer you only lentils? ג' עמו וכ' he tried to live with him on lentils, and died. Ib. 111
<sup>a</sup> ג' בעצמו he conquered his love and remained single. Y. ib. VII, beg. 31
<sup>b</sup> מגלגלת עמו וכ' she has to bear with him thirty days longer. Y. Yeb. VIII, 8
<sup>d</sup> top גַּלְגֵּל עמהן וכ' bear with them twelve months (give them time for reconsideration).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְגַּלְגֵּל, הִגַּ', </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpalp</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְגַּלְגֵּל </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be rolled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. X, 3 נ' הספר מידו the scroll rolled out of his hands (down the roof). Ḥall. III, 1 עד שתִּתְגַּלְגֵּל בחטים in the case of wheat flour, until it (the dough) is rolled, v. supra. Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>c</sup> top; Y. Keth. XII, 35
<sup>b</sup> top מִתְגַּלְגְּלִין their bodies are rolled underground, v. גִּלְגּוּל. B. Kam. 17
<sup>b</sup> ונתג' למקום אחר but the barrel rolled to another place. Pesik. R. s. 6 מא"י נִתְגַּלְגְלָה וכ' from Palestine it (the stone) rolled and arrived just for this momentary use; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be turned, changed, transferred, caused</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIX נתגלגלה המלכות על וכ' the royal dignity was transferred on Esther. Shebu. VII, 8 נ' לו שבועה וכ' if by chance an oath is imposed upon him in another law-suit (with the same persons), the court makes him swear by implication &c.; v. גִּלְגּוּל.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (of waters) 
<italic>to tower, gather</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Pirké d’R. El. ch. V; ch. XXIII.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (with רחמים) 
<italic>to prevail</italic> (over hatred &c.), 
<italic>be moved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 20 נִתְגַּלְגְּלוּ רחמיו וכ' the Lord’s compassion was moved. Tanḥ. Vayigg. 4; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—5)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to throw one’s self upon, to attack</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yalk. Is. 350 (ib. 288 נתגאה).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="C00871">

<pos> m.</pos>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>wheel</italic>, esp. 
<italic>the wheel-work at wells, crane</italic> &c. Midd. V, 4.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. B. Bath. II, 16 
<pgbrk id="pg245" />בית גולגל לרבים ed. Zuck. (Var. גילגל) a public well. B. Bath. IV, 5 את הג' the crane of the wine or oil press, v. חוּמַרְתָּא. Erub. X, 14; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>globe, celestial sphere</italic>, esp. 
<italic>the sphere of the zodiac</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 20
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. ג' חמה the revolution of the Sun. Pes. 94
<sup>b</sup> ג' קבוע ומזלות וכ' the sphere of the zodiac is stationary, and the planets make the circuit; ג' חוזר וכ' the sphere (wheel) turns around and the planets are stationary; a. fr.—B. Bath. 16
<sup>b</sup> Ms. M. מה עדש זה דומה לג' וכ' as the lentil resembles a sphere, so is mourning a sphere making a circuit in the world; (diff. in ed., v. גִּלְגֵּל); Yalk. Gen. 110 מה עדשים האלו ג' וכ'.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>the eye-ball</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 42; Lev. R. s. 11; Ruth R. introd. 6 (ref. to עין משפט Gen. XIV, 7) ג' עינו של עולם the eye-ball of the world (Abraham). Snh. 108
<sup>a</sup> בשביל ג' העין וכ' on account of (the covetousness of) the eye-ball (v. next w.); a. e.—

<sup>a</sup> אִגְלֵי I will leave home; גלא לבי רומאי he emigrated into Roman territory. Pes. 49
<sup>a</sup> לא גְלָאִי I should not have emigrated; לא גלאי כדגָלֵי אינשי I did not emigrate (voluntarily) as others do. Koh. R. to IX, 10 את הוית גָּלֵי וכ', v. אֲלַף II.—Part. גָּלֵי, pl. גָּלַיָּא, f. גָּלָן 
<italic>exiles</italic>. Targ. Nah. II, 8 בגָלַיָּא ed. among the exiles (on foot; ed. Lag. בגִילַּיָּא, v. גִּילּוּיָא, h. text גֻּלְּתָה). Targ. Am. VI, 7 גָּלָן the exiled communities.—Targ. II Kings XXIII, 6 קברי ג' (some ed. גַּלּ') the graves of the homeless (h. text בני העם).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. גֱּלֵי, גֲּלִי, גְּ', גַּלְיָא 
<italic>known, revealed; uncovered.</italic> Dan. II, 19; 30. Targ. Job XXIII, 10. Targ. I Sam. III, 1; a. fr.—Targ. O. Ex. XIV, 8 בריש ג' openly (h. text ביד רמה).</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>b</sup> ג' לדרעיה he uncovered his arm. Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>a</sup>; Yoma 84
<sup>a</sup> דלא מְגַלִּית that thou wilt not divulge it. Ib. מְגַלִּינָא I shall divulge. Ḥull. 113
<sup>a</sup> תנא סיפא לגַלּוּיֵי רישא the second clause is stated in order to throw light on the first. Gitt. 34
<sup>a</sup> גַּלּוּיֵי דעתא, v. גִּילּוּיָּא. Y. Maasr. V, end, 52
<sup>a</sup> מן דגַלִּית לך חספא אשכחת מרגניתא (not דגליית) after I removed the potsherd, thou foundest the pearl, i.e. but for my teaching, you would not have found the truth which you now claim as your own discovery; Y. Keth. IX, 33
<sup>b</sup> bot. (corr. acc.); [in Babli דלאית, v. דלי].</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be uncovered, revealed</italic> &c. Targ. Is. LXII, 1.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> אִיגְּלָאִי מלתא the fact became known. R. Hash. 22
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. כל מילתא דעבידא לאִיגְּלוּיֵי וכ' people are not presumed to tell a lie which is likely to be found out. Sot. 22

<italic>alil</italic> לישנא דמִיגְּלֵי הוא has the meaning of being clearly visible? Ab. Zar. 30

<sup>a</sup> מִגְּלוּ וקיימי remain visible; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to be led into captivity</italic>.</definition>
